analysis.rationale: R0 pipeline re-confirmed and strengthened by quantitative per-pair evidence. (1) Type: per-pair multiplicative coefficient c_hat = sqrt(mean(res^2)/mean(I^2)) over 10<I<245 = 0.1368/0.1315/0.1379/0.1245/0.1363 (mean 0.1334, sd 0.0049), equal across R/G/B (diffs <=0.003) -> multiplicative, channel-independent noise with c=0.14 = noise_speckle sev1. Additive gaussian would give c_hat proportional to 1/RMS(I) (cross-pair spread ~2x); observed spread is 1.1x. (2) Severity: sev2 (c=0.21) excluded by 5/5 WEAK and residual_std 45-48% too high. (3) Missed-signal audit: pair3 run_full_analysis flagged POISSON (ivcs=-0.013) and SATURATION_strengthen_sev3 (chroma 1.2261); both are content-driven false positives: speckle:1 simulation reproduces pair3 chroma_ratio 1.226->1.226 and variance_ratio 1.0224->1.0223 exactly, and also pairs 1/4 chroma 1.733/1.617->1.734/1.617, so no global step; POISSON label stems from noise_prior intensity-scaled variance on bright content where clipping flattens the var-intensity relation. (4) Compression excluded: block_boundary 0.999-1.018 (0% FP), unique_G 244-256, JPEG-combo block_boundary diff 105%. (5) Blur excluded: spectral_slope_ratio 0.994-1.006, FFT anisotropy 0.00; gm_ratio 2.1-4.6 is noise-gradient driven. Verdict remains UNCERTAIN per SKILL (noise seed mismatch, no LIKELY for noise steps).
